1308-2034-5220-6961-8347.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
1308-2034-5220-6961-8347.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Sela triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

4279-5708-6026--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-5708-6026--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Vein Ripper, Field of Souls and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Field of Souls ability, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vein Ripper triggers, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

34-147-728.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
34-147-728.description:
Cast Footsteps of the Goryo by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Footsteps of the Goryo.
Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Footsteps of the Goryo
Resolve the Footsteps of the Goryo copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

240-1322-4247-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

requires.n: Goblin, Orc or Army Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

392-5147-5220-7855--180.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Goblin, Orc or Army
When the Goblin, Orc or Army dies, The Great Goblin's second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the Goblin, Orc or Army onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Great Goblin trigger, exiling the Goblin, Orc or Army from the top of your library with the ability to play it until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability
Cast the Goblin, Orc or Army from exile by paying its mana cost.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}
Repeat
392-5147-5220-7855--180.notes: The chosen Goblin, Orc or Army must be castable for {R}.

618-1484-4456-7494.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, copying Blazing Firesinger. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Cast a copy of Seething Song by paying {1}{R} due to Primal Amulet // Primal Wellspring.
Hematite Talisman triggers, causing you to pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1978-5517-7308.description:
Activate Mona Lisa by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Mona Lisa.
Repeat

2440-3581-4460-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Spirit you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Spirit token.
Activate the Spirit token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2440-3581-4460-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced to as little as {1} if you control other Spirits. You can also sacrifice the Spirits once you have enough to get infinite {R}.

3401-5776-5803.manaNeeded: {11}{U}{U} minus {1} for each other artifact you control
3401-5776-5803.notablePrerequisites:
Kitsa has power 2 or greater and does not have summoning sickness.
Artifacts you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
3401-5776-5803.description:
Cast Blinkmoth Infusion by paying {12}{U}{U}, minus {1} for each artifact you control.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate any number of mana-producing artifacts you control, adding at least {2}.
Activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Blinkmoth Infusion.
Resolve the copy of Blinkmoth Infusion, untapping all artifacts you control.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

2981-3108-6972--112.description:
If Grim Poppet has any -1/-1 counters on it, activate it by removing a -1/-1 counter from it.
Repeat step 1 as necessary until Grim Poppet has no -1/-1 counters on it.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Grim Poppet.
When Grim Poppet dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.
Resolve all Grim Poppet abilities, putting infinite -1/-1 counters on any number of creatures.
2981-3108-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost toughness by at least 1 to prevent Grim Poppet from dying due to the -1/-1 counters. You can perform this combo as a lock whenever a creature enters the battlefield to put -1/-1 counters on that creature and cause it to die.

5010-5256-5708-6900.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Vein Ripper trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
Repeat.

632-2034-3621-5129-6965.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Cast Scarecrone by paying {3}.
When Scarecrone enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Scarecrone.
Activate the nontoken Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Scarecrone, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Su-Chi Cave Guards, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guards die, they trigger, adding 16 {C}.
Activate the token Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Scarecrone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
632-2034-3621-5129-6965.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Scarecrones to their first abilities.

1482-2173-2854-4574.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1482-2173-2854-4574.description:
Cast Jeweled Lotus either from your hand by paying {0} or from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

1447-2719-6797.description:
Cast Angel of Glory's Rise by paying {5}{W}{W}.
When Angel of Glory's Rise enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sakashima of a Thousand Faces
Resolve the Angel of Glory's Rise trigger, exiling all Zombies, and then returning all Humans from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Choose to have Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enter the battlefield as a copy of Angel of Glory's Rise.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

1563-2457-2557-3480.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

1744-3430.description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, creating five token copies of Nyxbloom Ancient.
Whenever you tap a permanent for mana, you will add 729 times as much mana due to the Nyxbloom Ancients.

803-1789-2292-5649.notablePrerequisites: Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Dragon" chosen.
803-1789-2292-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

511-817-1270-1887-4050.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

654-5411-5720-5721.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
Lands you control and/or land cards in your graveyard that enter the battlefield untapped can tap to produce at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
654-5411-5720-5721.description:
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

128-1339-1950.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to draw a card.
There is at least one Insect on the battlefield.
128-1339-1950.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield as a 3/3 due to Coat of Arms, Elemental Bond triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
128-1339-1950.notes: This combo will result in you drawing your library, and losing the game if it isn't interacted with. Ensure you have a way to avoid this before starting the combo.

140-889-2871-5231.notablePrerequisites:
You have lost at least 3 life this turn.
Rowan does not have summoning sickness.
140-889-2871-5231.description:
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn by at least {3}.
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {R} due to Rowan's ability, targeting any creature.
Deekah triggers, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token, then putting a +1/+1 counter on the Fractal.
Resolve Seething Anger, giving target creature +3/+0 until end of turn and returning Seething Anger to your hand.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Fractal, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2.

723-1007-1167.manaNeeded: {4}{W} the first turn, with {10}{W} available each following turn
723-1007-1167.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other white permanent.
723-1007-1167.description:
Activate Mindslaver by paying {4}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to gain control of target opponent during their next turn.
Activate Mistveil Plains by paying {W} and tapping it, putting Mindslaver on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
During your next turn, activate Captain Sisay by tapping it, searching your library for Mindslaver and putting it into your hand.
Cast Mindslaver by paying {6}.
Repeat.

643-703-909-1729.description:
Cast Tajuru Archer by paying {2}{G}.
When Tajuru Archer enters the battlefield, it triggers, dealing at least three damage to Astral Dragon.
Astral Dragon dies as a state-based action due to Tajuru Archer's deathtouch, granted to it by Shelob and Maskwood Nexus.
Shelob triggers, creating a token copy of Astral Dragon that is a Food artifact.
When the token Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two token copies of itself that are 3/3 Dragons in addition to its other types.
When the Astral Dragon creature tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, targeting the Astral Dragon Food token and, optionally, any other noncreature permanent.
Resolve the first Astral Dragon creature token trigger, creating two token copies of the Astral Dragon Food token that are 3/3 Dragons in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 6.
If you chose to target a different permanent in step 6, you may resolve those abilities, creating infinite copies of any noncreature permanent.

2034-2724-3049-3687-3987.notablePrerequisites:
Sophina and at least two other nontoken creatures you control do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
2034-2724-3049-3687-3987.description:
Declare Sophina and two other nontoken creatures as attackers.
Sophina triggers, creating three Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wormfang Manta, adding {C}{C}.
Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
If Wormfang Manta was put onto the battlefield by Havengul Mystery, Havengul Mystery triggers, transforming itself.
Activate the Clue tokens by paying {6}, tapping and sacrificing them, causing you to draw three cards.
At the beginning of your end step, Havengul Laboratory triggers, transforming itself.
Havengul Mystery triggers, returning Wormfang Manta from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

628-2438-4968.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 1 until Deathbringer Thoctar has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Deathbringer Thoctar.
Deathbringer Thoctar dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
